title: Packing
intro: 1. Valid passports — valid until March 2027 minimum; both travelers 2. China visa (in passport or printed approval letter) 3. Vietnam e-visa printed copies (2 each; one in carry-on, one in checked) 4. Travel insurance policy number + 24/7 emergency line — saved in phone AND on paper 5. VPN activated on both phones (ExpressVPN/NordVPN — must be installed BEFORE China entry) 6. All eSIMs activated (Airalo China + Vietnam eSIMs downloaded and QR codes saved) 7. Multi-currency debit card (Charles Schwab) + backup credit card; both banks notified 8. Prescription medications (14-day supply + 3 days buffer; original prescriptions in carry-on) 9. Universal travel adapter (both China and Vietnam use A and C type plugs; one universal covers both) 20,000 mAh USB-C power bank (checked for airline Wh compliance) 10. DEET 30% insect repellent — mosquito risk in Vietnam 11. SPF 50 sunscreen (2 bottles — expensive at Vietnam resorts) 12. Compression packing cubes — enables expansion for return shopping haul 13. Lightweight packable daypack — for Great Wall hike; beach days; daily city use 14. CBP Form 4457 (US Customs pre-registration of valuable items taken FROM US: watches, jewelry) 15. Copies of all hotel bookings, flight confirmations — in both cloud (via VPN) and printed

bullets.heading: Country-Specific Gear
items: Comfortable walking shoes with grip (required for Great Wall uneven steps)
Light layer / cardigan (Beijing AC is aggressive indoors; temples can be cool even in September)
Small umbrella (foldable) — afternoon rain showers possible
Temple-appropriate clothing (shoulders + knees covered): one pair trousers + short-sleeve shirt
Camera (real camera, not just phone) for Great Wall + Forbidden City + Jingshan sunset
Swimwear (2 sets minimum — daily beach use)
Light linen/cotton shirts (humidity is intense; synthetic fabrics are miserable)
Rain poncho/jacket (typhoon season; more useful than umbrella in heavy rain)
Long sleeve light layer for mosquito protection at evening outdoor dining
Modest temple wear (same as China or buy a ₫100,000 linen shirt in Hội An — perfect solution)
Underwater camera / GoPro for Cham Islands potential snorkeling and beach

bullets.heading: Duty-Free / Shopping Bag Strategy
items: Outbound: Pack one lightweight foldable duffel bag (Osprey Ultralight or similar) compressed in main luggage; will become second checked bag on return
In Hội An: Tailor will pack garments in garment bags; ask for compression option for suits
Heavy/bulky marble: Non Nước Stone Village ships internationally; get shipping quote; not worth carrying
Valuables in carry-on: All watches, jewelry, and items on CBP Form 4457 go in carry-on for return
One rule: If it doesn't fit without straining the zipper, ship it (DHL Vietnam: reliable, door-to-door, 7–10 days to US)

bullets.heading: Printable Packing Checklist
items: [ ] China visa approved and in passport
[ ] CBP Form 4457 for high-value US items
[ ] Offline maps downloaded (Baidu Maps, Google Maps, Maps.me)
[ ] All apps installed (DiDi, Grab, WeChat, Airalo eSIM)

climate.caption: September Climate
climate.text: Beijing shoulder (20–26°C); Vietnam warm-humid with typhoon tail risk in central coast.
climate.note: Schedule outdoor Vietnam time early AM / evening.
